title: Two stale continue-on-error steps in ci.yml mask real failures; stated exit conditions already met
symptom: Two continue-on-error steps remain after their documented exit conditions were met, so failures are reported and ignored. Source linters reports success via API while its log contains exit code 1.
root_cause: (1) GH #428 closed and test-transition now passes, but its mask was never removed. (2) lint_test_isolation baseline keys on line number via issue_key(); PR #490 shifted helpers.zig lines 388/393/394 -> 432/437/438 without regenerating the baseline, so 3 entries stopped matching.
notes: Install Zig's continue-on-error is legitimate: fallback pair, Confirm Zig is on PATH hard-fails if both routes fail.
Distinct from ISS-0170 (runner starvation), which fabricates false red rather than hiding real red.
